description: This file contains functions for exporting observation and event data in various formats for the BORIS behavioral observation software. It includes functions to export detailed event tables, aggregated data, behavioral sequences, and related helper functions, along with importing external dependencies and project-specific modules.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] export_events_jwatcher( parameters: dict, obsId: str, observation: list, ethogram: dict, file_name: str, output_format: str )
methods.description: Exports events data in jwatcher .dat format, creating data and metadata files with options for overwriting existing files.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] export_tabular_events( pj: dict, parameters: dict, obs_id: str, observation: dict, ethogram: dict, file_name: str, output_format: str )
methods.description: Exports observation events into tabular formats such as CSV, Excel, or pandas DataFrame, supporting detailed event information, media data, and modifiers.

methods.name: tuple dataset_write(dataset: tablib.Dataset, file_name: str, output_format: str, dtype: dict = {})
methods.description: Writes a tablib dataset to a file in the specified format, handling pandas DataFrame, RDS, CSV, TSV, HTML, ODS, XLS, and XLSX formats.

methods.name: Tuple[tablib.Dataset,int] export_aggregated_events(pj: dict, parameters: dict, obsId: str, force_number_modifiers: int = 0)
methods.description: Exports aggregated events statistics from the database for a given observation, subject, and behavior, with options for forcing number of modifiers.

methods.name: str events_to_behavioral_sequences(pj, obs_id: str, subj: str, parameters: dict, behav_seq_separator: str)
methods.description: Converts event data into a string representation of behavioral sequences for a particular subject in an observation.

methods.name: str events_to_behavioral_sequences_all_subj(pj, obs_id: str, subjects_list: list, parameters: dict, behav_seq_separator: str)
methods.description: Creates combined behavioral sequences for all selected subjects within an observation.

methods.name: str events_to_timed_behavioral_sequences( pj: dict, obs_id: str, subject: str, parameters: dict, precision: float, behav_seq_separator: str )
methods.description: Generates time-scan sample behavioral sequences for a subject with specified temporal resolution.

methods.name: observation_to_behavioral_sequences(pj, selected_observations, parameters, behaviors_separator, separated_subjects, timed, file_name)
methods.description: Outputs behavioral sequences or summaries for multiple observations possibly with additional metadata and media info.
